reason: A local developer toolbox providing a broad set of text, encoding, data, security, extraction, conversion, reference, and efficiency utilities through a sidebar UI and /toolbox command, with optional file, agent, and HTTP capabilities.

summaries.zh: 提供侧边栏界面和 /toolbox 命令的本地开发工具箱，包含文本、编码、数据、安全、提取、转换等多类实用工具。
summaries.en: A local developer toolbox offering sidebar and /toolbox access to utilities for text, encoding, data, security, extraction, conversion, and related tasks.

capabilities: Runs local text, encoding, data, security, extraction, conversion, reference, and utility operations
Can optionally expose selected toolbox functions as agent tools
Can read files for hashing or encoding when enabled
Can save generated output to a configured project directory
Can send HTTP requests when the http_request tool is used
Supports user-defined local JavaScript tools through configuration
